title: How to Use Claude Code Skills for Better Python Docstrings
description: Learn how to use Claude Code skills to write consistent Python docstrings, with style references and a helper script you can reuse in every project.
summary: With Claude Code skills, you can turn a docstring convention you keep re-explaining into instructions that Claude follows on its own. After working through this guide, you can write consistent Python docstrings with a reusable Claude Code skill.
takeaways: Free Bonus: Claude Code Cheat Sheet Get a Claude Code Cheat Sheet (PDF) with slash commands, shortcuts, CLI flags, CLAUDE.md, permissions, hooks, skills, subagents, and MCP on two printable pages: Prerequisites You’ll need Claude Code installed and signed in , plus Python 3.12 or later for the helper in Step 3.

Claude Code Live Course: If you’d rather learn Claude Code hands-on with an instructor, Real Python’s Claude Code live course guides you through building a complete Python project with it, reusable skills included.
After working through this guide, you can write consistent Python docstrings with a reusable Claude Code skill.
